purpose: The approved cost lines a Bulgarian purchase involves, behind the listing-page cost estimator. The estimator refuses to produce a total unless every required line for the buyer scope resolves to an approved, in-effect record whose approval is no older than the record allows.
publishing_note: This repository holds no approved fee rates. Add only current, sourced fee lines with a named reviewer and approved_at, then recompute source_hash with production/scripts/build-approved-content.mjs. Until then the estimator must refuse to total.
